title: Discrete Signal Generation
aim: To write MATLAB/Python code to generate discrete impulses, steps, ramps, and sinusoidal waveforms.

theory.summary: Discrete-time signals are represented as sequences of numbers. The fundamental signals used in DSP analysis are: 1. Unit Impulse delta[n] (1 at n=0, 0 elsewhere), 2. Unit Step u[n] (1 for n>=0, 0 elsewhere), 3. Unit Ramp r[n] (n for n>=0, 0 elsewhere), and 4. Discrete Sinusoid x[n] = A * sin(2*pi*f*n + phi) where f is the normalized digital frequency. These signals serve as basis functions for characterizing linear time-invariant (LTI) systems.

key_formulas.name: Normalized digital frequency
key_formulas.variables: F = analog frequency in Hz, Fs = sampling rate in Hz

procedure: Step 1: Set up the time index vector n from -10 to 10.
Step 2: Generate the Unit Impulse signal: define a vector of zeros, and set the value corresponding to n=0 to 1.
Step 3: Generate the Unit Step signal: define a vector that is 1 for all indices where n >= 0, and 0 otherwise.
Step 4: Generate the Unit Ramp signal: multiply the Unit Step signal vector by the time index vector n.
Step 5: Generate the Discrete Sinusoidal signal: set sample rate Fs = 1000Hz, signal frequency F = 50Hz, and generate x[n] = sin(2*pi*(F/Fs)*n) for n = 0 to 50.
Step 6: Plot all signals using stem plots (discrete time representation) with proper labels and legends.

observations.what_to_plot: Discrete stem plots of amplitude vs sample index n for each signal.

expected_results.description: The generated plots must display discrete sequences of values as individual stems. The impulse should be a single peak at n=0, the step should be flat from n=0 onwards, the ramp should increase linearly, and the sinusoid should show a periodic oscillation.

common_errors.symptom: Plots show continuous lines instead of discrete points
causes: Used plt.plot() instead of plt.stem() in Python or plot() instead of stem() in MATLAB
common_errors.fix: Replace standard line plotting functions with stem functions to represent discrete time sequences.

common_errors.symptom: The sinusoidal plot appears aliased or distorted
causes: Sampling frequency Fs is set too low (less than Nyquist rate 2F)
common_errors.fix: Ensure Fs >= 2 * F to satisfy the Nyquist sampling criterion.

viva_questions.q: Why do we use stem plots instead of line plots in DSP?
viva_questions.a: Discrete-time signals are only defined at integer sample indices. Line plots imply values exist between samples, which is incorrect in discrete-time systems.

viva_questions.q: What is the relation between analog frequency F and digital frequency f?
viva_questions.a: Digital frequency f = F/Fs, measured in cycles/sample, where Fs is the sampling rate.

viva_questions.q: How is the unit ramp function mathematically related to the unit step function?
viva_questions.a: The unit ramp r[n] can be defined as n * u[n], where u[n] is the unit step function.
